title: 第十章 帝王级待遇
slug: 纨绔女修四处撩绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苍岚握着铃铛，久久没有松手。

萧姚托着腮，打量着他的神色。

眼圈还有点红，耳朵尖在轻轻晃动。

看来耗费精力表心意这招，有用！

萧姚眼中笑意加深，在脑海里跟025嘚瑟：

【统子，看见没，海王随便一出手，就给他感动哭了。】

025忍不住咂舌。

这纨绔还真有两把刷子，戳软肋戳得那叫一个准。

【不愧是你啊宿主，连攻略男人都像个入室抢劫的悍匪。我感觉一年的时间给多了，真的！】

萧姚厚脸皮地应下，直接把025的阴阳怪气当表扬，连血红的倒计时都越看越顺眼。

她甩甩酸胀的手腕，顺手摸摸闻声转过来的狼耳，毫不心虚地画饼：

“乖，跟着姐姐混，保证你一天吃九顿。”

苍岚的狗狗眼水汪汪的，带着惊喜和不知所措。

“姐姐不用对苍岚那么好……苍岚能有自己的住处，不用担心风吹雨淋，不会在睡着后被人欺负，就已经很知足了。”

苍岚的狼耳微微颤动，声音逐渐低了下去，像是回想起不堪回首的经历。

“姐姐冒着被责骂的风险带苍岚摆脱困境，苍岚又怎么能再给姐姐增添负担呢？”

“姐姐可是炼器时间太久，手腕酸痛不适？让苍岚帮姐姐按揉一下吧，否则，苍岚心里会不安的。”

有人愿意服务，萧姚自然不会端着，让自己白白受委屈。

她伸出右臂，拖着慵懒的尾音，懒散道：

“小狼好会心疼人，把你捡回来，姐姐以后可以享福咯～”

苍岚的耳朵趴了趴，隔着衣料轻捏慢揉，腼腆地笑着开口：

“姐姐愿意给苍岚报恩的机会，是苍岚的荣幸呢。”

苍岚仔细观察萧姚的表情，感受她手腕的放松程度，小心调整手上的力度，努力把这个力道刻在心里。

他反复自我催眠：全都是为了潜移默化得让她离不开自己，他所做的一切只有利用，绝无真心！

萧姚喟叹一声，享受地眯起眼。

这就是帝王级体验吗？她喜欢！

虽然他接近她的目的并不单纯，但只要他不黑化，那她留着他也不是不行。

毕竟，长得好看、声音好听、还能提供情绪价值的毛茸茸，可真的不好找。

“姐姐，这种力度可以吗？只要姐姐喜欢，苍岚可以天天给姐姐捏肩捶腿。只要能让姐姐舒心，苍岚都愿意去学。”

苍岚声音又轻又软，像团被太阳晒得蓬松的棉团。

萧姚脸上露出标准的乐不思蜀式笑容，反问道：

“不好好修炼，在这些琐事上浪费时间，不觉得委屈？”

苍岚一脸认真地看着萧姚回答：

Cang Lan held the bell and didn't let go for a long time.

Xiao Yao held his chin and looked at his expression.

The eye circles are still a little red, and the tips of the ears are shaking slightly.

It seems that this method of using energy to express your feelings works!

The smile in Xiao Yao's eyes deepened, and he whispered to 025 in his mind:

[Tongzi, did you see that Poseidon made him cry when he made a random move?】

025 couldn't help but click his tongue.

This dude really has two brushes, and he is very accurate at poking at weak spots.

[As expected of you, host, even the raider man looks like a ruthless gangster.I feel like one year is too much time, really!】

Xiao Yao responded shamelessly, directly taking 025's strangeness as a compliment, and even the blood-red countdown became more and more pleasing to the eye.

She shook her sore wrist, touched the wolf's ears that turned around after hearing the sound, and said without any guilt:

"Be good, hang out with my sister, and I'll make sure you eat nine meals a day."

Cang Lan's dog's eyes were watery, filled with surprise and confusion.

"Sister, you don't have to be so nice to Cang Lan... Cang Lan is already satisfied if she can have her own place to live, and doesn't have to worry about being exposed to wind or rain, or being bullied after falling asleep."

Cang Lan's wolf ears trembled slightly, and her voice gradually became lower, as if recalling an unbearable experience.

"My sister took the risk of being scolded to get Cang Lan out of trouble. How can Cang Lan add another burden to her sister?"

"Sister, you have been refining the weapon for too long and your wrist is sore and uncomfortable? Let Cang Lan massage it for you. Otherwise, Cang Lan will feel uneasy."

If someone is willing to serve, Xiao Yao will naturally not hold back and let himself be wronged in vain.

She stretched out her right arm and said lazily:

"Little Wolf knows how to care for others. If I pick you up, my sister can enjoy happiness in the future~"

Cang Lan's ears lay flat, she gently pinched and rubbed them slowly through the fabric of her clothes, then she smiled shyly and said:

"It is Cang Lan's honor that my sister is willing to give Cang Lan a chance to repay her kindness."

Cang Lan carefully observed Xiao Yao's expression, felt how relaxed her wrist was, carefully adjusted the strength of her hand, and tried to keep this strength in her heart.

He repeatedly hypnotized herself: all in order to subtly make her unable to live without him. All he did was to use her, and there was absolutely no sincerity!

Xiao Yao sighed and narrowed his eyes in enjoyment.

Is this an imperial experience?She likes it!

Although his purpose of approaching her was not pure, as long as he did not turn evil, it was not impossible for her to keep him.

After all, it’s really hard to find furries that look good, sound good, and provide emotional value.

"Sister, is this kind of intensity okay? As long as my sister likes it, Cang Lan can squeeze her shoulders and beat her legs every day. As long as it makes her feel comfortable, Cang Lan is willing to learn."

Cang Lan's voice was light and soft, like a ball of cotton fluffed by the sun.

Xiao Yao showed a standard happy-go-lucky smile on his face and asked:

"Don't you feel aggrieved if you don't practice hard and waste time on these trivial matters?"

Cang Lan looked at Xiao Yao seriously and replied:
